name: N2-acetyl-L-ornithine to D-ribulose
summary: A 10-step route from N2-acetyl-L-ornithine zwitterion to D-ribulose, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: N-acetylornithine carbamoyltransferase
reactions.equation: N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine + carbamoyl phosphate = N(2)-acetyl-L-citrulline + phosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: argininosuccinate synthase
reactions.equation: L-citrulline + L-aspartate + ATP = 2-(N(omega)-L-arginino)succinate + AMP + diphosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: L-cysteinyl-[NO transferase protein] + N(omega)-hydroxy-L-arginine + O2 = S-nitroso-L-c...
reactions.equation: L-cysteinyl-[NO transferase protein] + N(omega)-hydroxy-L-arginine + O2 = S-nitroso-L-cysteinyl-[NO transferase protein] + L-citrulline + H2O + H(+)

reactions.name: L-cysteinyl-[NO transferase protein] + L-arginine + NADPH + 2 O2 = S-nitroso-L-cysteiny...
reactions.equation: L-cysteinyl-[NO transferase protein] + L-arginine + NADPH + 2 O2 = S-nitroso-L-cysteinyl-[NO transferase protein] + L-citrulline + NADP(+) + 2 H2O

reactions.name: L-arginine + NADH + O2 + H(+) = N(omega)-hydroxy-L-arginine + NAD(+) + H2O
reactions.equation: L-arginine + NADH + O2 + H(+) = N(omega)-hydroxy-L-arginine + NAD(+) + H2O

reactions.name: L-arginine dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: L-arginine + NAD(+) + H2O = 5-guanidino-2-oxopentanoate + NH4(+) + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: putrescine carbamoyltransferase
reactions.equation: carbamoyl phosphate + putrescine = N-carbamoylputrescine + phosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: L-arginine + ADP + phosphate + H(+) = L-citrulline + NH4(+) + ATP
reactions.equation: L-arginine + ADP + phosphate + H(+) = L-citrulline + NH4(+) + ATP

reactions.name: L-arginine--[L-arginyl-carrier protein] ligase
reactions.equation: holo-[peptidyl-carrier protein] + L-arginine + ATP = L-arginyl-[peptidyl-carrier protein] + AMP + diphosphate

reactions.name: ATP citrate synthase
reactions.equation: oxaloacetate + acetyl-CoA + ADP + phosphate = citrate + ATP + CoA
